name: spotifycares-support-triage

source.dataset: Customer Support on Twitter (Thought Vector, Kaggle)

task: intent classification (11 classes) + auto-handle vs escalate with a reason (6 codes)

splits.rating: 60 blinded drafts for judge-vs-human agreement, sampled from runs/final_vertex

files.note: Resampled 2026-09-30 from runs/final_vertex. The rating set is a sample of DRAFTS, so it is tied to the run that produced them; judging stand-in drafts would not validate the judge that scored the live run. The golden messages and labels below are unchanged, which is why the version is not bumped.

hashing: sha256 of file content with CRLF normalised to LF
